Wispr Flow turns your voice into clean, ready-to-send text in any app, so you can type up to 4x faster just by talking.
Want to suggest a guest?
Rakesh Asthana is a 1984-batch Gujarat cadre IPS officer and former Special Director of the CBI. He headed the Gujarat Police SIT on the 2002 Godhra train burning. Priyanshi Jain is a forensic expert and educator who works directly with the police. Together they break down how a crime actually gets solved, from the first yellow tape to the courtroom. Grounded, procedural, and blunt about what TV gets wrong.
